notes.title: About the next update
notes.content:
Hi, thank you for purchasing my game. Many people have been asking about localizing it into other languages. I just wanted to say that it's in my plans, but I have something more important to focus on at the moment. I want to add 1-2 sex scenes to reward players who achieve the best ending. I will update the game with these scenes within the next 2-3 weeks.

I've noticed that many players are unable to complete the "Secret Files" achievement, and it makes me feel sad. Do you guys need a walkthrough to help you? However, if you are able to find it on your own, you will be pleasantly surprised.
